paper: SS014 - AI-Powered Unit Test Generation via Multi-LLM Chaining: A Case Study With GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude-3.5
metrics: branch coverage, line coverage, mutation score
main_result: Gemini + GPT-4o chaining achieved 99.05% branch coverage and 94.32% mutation score, outperforming Randoop and single-LLMs.
limitation: Evaluated only on HumanEval dataset, which consists of small, self-contained functions.

paper: SS032 - Automatic Unit Test Generation for Programming Assignments Using Large Language Models
venue: 2025 IEEE/ACM 37th International Conference on Software Engineering Education and Training (CSEE&T)
metrics: statement coverage, mutation score, compilation success rate
main_result: Augmented GPT-4o-mini approach improved statement coverage and mutation scores by 1.7x and 2.1x respectively compared to vanilla setting.
limitation: Evaluated on a small number of programming assignments (6 tasks) in an educational context.

paper: SS040 - Benchmarking LLMs for Unit Test Generation from Real-World Functions
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
metrics: line coverage, branch coverage, mutation score
main_result: ULT benchmark mitigates data leakage, showing that GPT-4 achieves 74% coverage and 58% mutation score on real-world complex functions.
limitation: Evaluation budget is high due to multiple API calls required to generate and refine tests.

paper: SS047 - Clarifying Semantics of In-Context Examples for Unit Test Generation
venue: 2025 40th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE)
metrics: compilation success rate (CSR), pass rate (PR), line coverage, mutation score
main_result: CLAST refines tests to improve semantic clarity, increasing downstream compilation rate by 26% and coverage by 46% while preserving mutation scores.
limitation: Rewriting relies on LLM-based parsing which can occasionally introduce compilation errors.

paper: SS080 - Evaluating LLM-Generated Unit Tests with Mutation Testing: ChatGPT vs DeepSeek
venue: Anais do XXIV Simpósio Brasileiro de Qualidade de Software (SBQS 2025)
metrics: mutation score, mutant coverage, mutant elimination
main_result: GPT-4o outperforms DeepSeek V3 in generating unit tests that kill more mutants across different levels of cyclomatic complexity.
limitation: Evaluated on a small number of Defects4J classes (6 classes), which may limit generalizability.

paper: SS109 - Hallucination to Consensus: Multi-Agent LLMs for End-to-End JUnit Test Generation
venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
metrics: compilation rate, pass rate, branch coverage, mutation score
main_result: Multi-agent consensus framework significantly reduces hallucinations and generates JUnit tests with coverage and mutation scores comparable to human tests.
limitation: Multi-agent panel consensus requires high API costs and execution overhead.

paper: SS119 - IntelliUnitGen: A Unit Test Case Generation Framework Based on the Integration of Static Analysis and Prompt Learning
metrics: line coverage, branch coverage, mutation score
main_result: Integrating static analysis with prompt learning improves branch coverage and mutation scores, outperforming EvoSuite and vanilla LLMs.
limitation: Dependency on static analysis limits framework to languages with mature parsing tools.

paper: SS131 - Leveraging Long Method Decomposition to Improve Large Language Model-Based Test Case Generation
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
metrics: line coverage, branch coverage, mutation score
main_result: Method decomposition (DecoTest) improves LLM test generation for long methods, achieving 23% higher branch coverage than EvoSuite.
limitation: Method decomposition might not be applicable to highly coupled methods that cannot be easily refactored.

paper: SS137 - LLMLOOP: Improving LLM-Generated Code and Tests Through Automated Iterative Feedback Loops
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)
metrics: compilation rate, pass rate, branch coverage, mutation score
main_result: Automated iterative feedback loops (LLMLOOP) refine generated code and tests, achieving a 14% improvement in pass rate and higher mutation scores.
limitation: Iterative feedback loops can consume significant API tokens and build time.

paper: SS139 - LLMs for Automated Unit Test Generation and Assessment in Java: The AgoneTest Framework
venue: 2025 40th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE)
metrics: line coverage, branch coverage, mutation score, test smells
main_result: AgoneTest provides a standardized evaluation of LLMs, showing that GPT-4 achieves the highest mutation scores and lowest test smell rates.
limitation: Benchmark dataset CLASSES2TEST is limited to Java, and framework is language-specific.

paper: SS174 - Mutation-Guided Unit Test Generation With a Large Language Model
main_result: Mutation-guided generation (MutGen) uses mutation feedback to iteratively guide LLMs, achieving 18% higher mutation scores than EvoSuite.
limitation: High computational cost due to running mutation testing (Pitest) in the feedback loop.

paper: SS231 - Test Wars: A Comparative Study of SBST, Symbolic Execution, and LLM-Based Approaches to Unit Test Generation
venue: 2025 IEEE Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST)
metrics: line coverage, branch coverage, mutation score, defect detection rate
main_result: Test Wars study shows LLMs (TestSpark) achieve lower coverage than EvoSuite/Kex but significantly higher mutation scores, showing deeper semantic understanding.
limitation: LLM-based test generation is highly sensitive to the size of the class under test (CUT).
